senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (लाकयति)
1 To taste.
2 To obtain.

n. (-कं)
1 The forehead.
2 The ear or spike of wild rice.
E.
लक to taste, &c., aff. अच्.

m. (-चः)
A tree: see the next.

m. (-चः)
A species of the bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus Lacucha, Rox.)
E.
लक to taste, उच aff.; also अ substituted for उ, लकच.

m. (-कः)
1 Old and tattered cloth, a rag or rags.
2 Lac, the dye.
E.
लक to obtain, aff. क्त, and कन् added.

m. (-र्म्मा)
A tree used in dyeing, a red variety of the Lodh tree.
E.
लक्त for रक्त coloured, and कर्म्मन् office, act.

r. 10th cl. (लक्षयति-ते)
1 To see, to look at, to notice or inspect.
2 To mark, to make any mark on.
3 To define, to discriminate.
With उप prefixed,
To remark.
With सम्,
To know, to understand.

nf. (-क्षं-क्षा)
A Lac, one hundred thousand.
n. (-क्षं)
1 Fraud, disguise.
2 A mark or butt.
E.
लक्ष to mark, or see, aff. घञ्.

f. (-क्षा)
Lac, a red dye, or an insect which is analogous to the cochineal insect, and like it forms when dried and prepared, a dye of a red colour; the nest is formed of a resinous substance which is used as sealing wax, and is usually termed Shel lac.
E.
लक्ष to mark or stain, aff. अ, and अण् added, the vowel made long: or लक्ष a hundred thousand, and अण् aff.; made by a multitude of the insects.

n. (-णं)
1 A mark, a spot.
2 A name, an appellation.
3 Sight, seeing.
4 An indication, a predicate, any thing by which an object is designated or distinguished.
5 A symptom or any indication of actual disease.
m. (-णः)
1 The younger brother of RĀMA.
2 The Indian crane.
f. (-णा)
1 The female of the Indian crane.
2 A goose.
3 An ellipsis, a word, &c. understood, though not inserted.
4 The force or application of a word or phrase.
E.
लक्ष to see, to mark, aff. ल्युट्, or लक्ष as before, Uṇādi aff. न, and अट् augment; also with मुट् augment, लक्ष्मण, which in the masc. and fem. forms is the more usual reading.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Seen.
2 Marked.
E.
लक्ष to mark, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Prosperous, fortunate.
m. (-णः)
1 The son of DAŚARATHA by SUMITRĀ, the half-brother and faithful companion of RĀMACANDRA.
2 The Sāras or Indian crane.
n. (-णं)
1 A mark, a spot or sign.
2 A name, an appellation.
f. (-णा)
1 The female of the Sāras.
2 A kind of drug.
E.
लक्ष to mark or see, Uṇādi aff. न, and मुट् augment; also with अट् augment, लक्षण as above.

f. (-सूः)
SUMITRĀ, one of DAŚARATHA'S four wives, the mother of LAKṢMAṆA.
E.
लक्ष्मण, प्रसू the mother.

n. (-क्ष्म)
1 A mark, a spot, a sign.
2 Chief, principal.
E.
लक्ष to mark, &c., मनिन् aff.

f. (-क्ष्मीः)
1 LAKṢMĪ, one of the three principal female deities of the Hindus, the wife of VIṢṆU, and goddess of wealth and prosperity.
2 Fortune, success, prosperity.
3 SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA.
4 Beauty, splendour.
5 The name of a medicinal root, commonly Vṛddhi.
6 Another root, termed Ṛddhi.
7 A plant: see प्रियङ्गु.
8 The wife of a hero.
9 Turmeric.
10 A pearl.
E.
लक्ष to see, &c., Uṇādi aff. ई, and मुट् augment.

n. (-हं)
The red lotus.
E.
लक्ष्मी the goddess, and गृह abode, appearing at the creation, floating over the water on the expanded petals of the lotus.

m. (-तिः)
1 VIṢṆU.
2 A king, a sovereign prince.
3 The clove tree.
4 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel)
E.
लक्ष्मी the goddess of prosperity, and पति master, husband.

m. (-लः)
A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 KĀMADEVA, the god of love.
2 A horse.
3 Either of the sons of RĀMA and SĪTĀ.
E.
लक्ष्मी the goddess, or SĪTĀ, (she being LAKṢMĪ. incarnate,) and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-ष्पः)
A ruby.
E.
लक्ष्मी the goddess of fortune, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-मान्)
The bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
E.
लक्ष्मी prosperity, मतुप् aff., and the म unchanged.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Prosperous, fortunate, wealthy, thriving.
2 Beautiful.
E.
लक्ष्मी prosperity, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-शः)
1 VIṢṆU.
2 The mango tree.
3 A prosperous man.
E.
लक्ष्मी the goddess of fortune, and ईश lord.

m. (-जः)
The moon.
E.
लक्ष्मी the goddess, सह with, ज born; rising as well as LAKṢMĪ from the ocean, at the time it was churned by the gods and Asuras.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
1 To be seen or noted.
2 To be defined or described.
3 To have attributes or predicates attached.
n. (-क्ष्यं)
1 A mark, a butt.
2 A mark, a sign.
3 Fraud, disguise.
4 A Lac, a hundred thousand.
E.
लक्ष to see, यत् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Secondary, inferior, subordinate.
2 Indicatory, characteristic.
3 Technical.
m. (-कः)
A technical term, a word implying a definition.
E.
लक्षण, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Indicative, symptomatic, relating to a mark or sign, &c.
E.
लक्षण, and यञ् aff.

m. (-रुः)
The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
लाक्षा lac, and तरु a tree; the insect being especially found in this tree.

m. (-नः)
The red Lodh, a tree from the bark of which an astringent infusion is prepared, which is used to fix colour in dyeing.
E.
लाक्षा lac, and प्रसादन cleansing.

m. (-क्षः)
The Butea frondosa.
E.
लाक्षा the lac, and वृक्ष a tree: see लाक्षातरु.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Made of lac, &c.
2 Relating to a large number or a lakh.
E.
लाक्षा, and ठक् aff.
